register_map.notes: Pointer register selects one of four data registers. Pointer value is latched on write; subsequent reads without pointer byte read the same register.

read_channels.notes: 11-bit two's complement temperature data in Temp register.

access_model.notes: Pointer byte selects register; after pointer is set, reads can omit pointer byte. Writes always require pointer byte.

steps.notes: Wait for first conversion after power-up.

operation_flows.notes: Power-up default: normal mode, OS comparator, Tos=80°C, Thyst=75°C, OS active LOW, pointer=0.

steps.notes: Set pointer to Temp register (0x00), then read 2 bytes (MSB first).

outputs.notes: Raw 16-bit value from Temp register; only 11 MSB bits significant.

operation_flows.notes: If pointer already set to Temp, read can be done without pointer byte.

steps.notes: Write pointer byte 0x01 followed by configuration data byte.
Write pointer byte 0x03 followed by MS byte then LS byte.
Write pointer byte 0x02 followed by MS byte then LS byte.

raw_encoding.notes: Temp register: 2 bytes, MSB first; lower 5 bits unused. 11-bit two's complement in bits 15:5.

registers_or_commands.name: Tos
registers_or_commands.description: Over-temp shutdown threshold register, 9-bit two's complement data.

bitfields.name: OS Polarity
bitfields.description: 1 = OS active HIGH, 0 = OS active LOW (default).

bitfields.name: Tos data (9 bits)
bitfields.description: 9-bit two's complement over-temp shutdown threshold data.

init_sequence.notes: Power-up default: normal mode, OS comparator, Tos=80°C, Thyst=75°C, OS active LOW, pointer=0.
Wait ~100 ms for first conversion before reading temperature.

read_sequence.notes: Set pointer to Temp (0x00), then read 2 bytes (MSB first).

timing_constraints.name: power_up_valid_temp_wait
timing_constraints.notes: Wait ~100 ms before first valid Temp read.

conversion_formulae.name: temp_conversion
conversion_formulae.formula: Temp (degC) = raw_signed_11bit * 0.125, where raw_signed_11bit is the 11-bit two's complement value in bits D10..D0 of the 16-bit Temp register.
conversion_formulae.notes: Canonicalized: exact compensation is preserved in formula/inputs, but the single-line integer expression was marked non-executable because it is too complex or not accepted by the safe expression evaluator.

conversion_formulae.name: limit_conversion
conversion_formulae.formula: Limit (degC) = raw_signed_9bit * 0.5, where raw_signed_9bit is the 9-bit two's complement value in bits D8..D0 of the 16-bit register.

inputs.name: raw
inputs.description: 16-bit Tos or Thyst register; lower 7 bits unused.

error_conditions.name: i2c_nack
error_conditions.description: I2C NACK during write or read operation.
error_conditions.detection: Device does not acknowledge address or data byte.

error_conditions.name: measurement_timeout
error_conditions.description: Temperature conversion not completed within expected time.
error_conditions.detection: Read returns stale data if conversion not complete.
error_conditions.driver_action: Retry read after waiting conversion time.

power_states.name: normal
power_states.description: Normal operation mode, temperature conversion every 100 ms.

power_states.name: shutdown
power_states.description: Shutdown mode, conversion disabled, I2C active.
power_states.notes: Set by writing B0=1 in Conf register.

evidence_spans.snippet: the other four MSB bits of the address data are preset to '1001'
only 11 significant bits should be used, and the 5 LSB bits of the LS byte are zero and should be ignored.
the temp-to-digital conversion is executed every 100 ms
At power-up, the Pointer value is equal to 0 and the Temp register is selected
If the Temp data MSB bit D10 = 0 then the temperature is positive and Temp value (°C) = + (Temp data) * 0.125 °C
If the Temp data MSB bit D10 = 1 then the temperature is negative and Temp value (°C) = - (2's complement of Temp data) * 0.125 °C
only 9 significant bits should be used and the 7 LSB bits of the LS byte are equal to zero and should be ignored.
At power-up, the device is put into normal operation mode, the Tos is set to 80 °C, the Thyst is set to 75 °C
SCL clock period 2.5 µs
SCL HIGH pulse width 0.6 µs
SCL LOW pulse width 1.3 µs
Start Hold time 100 ns
Data set-up time 100 ns
Data hold time 0 ns
Stop set-up time 100 ns
Configuration Register. Contains a single 8-bit data byte.
Temperature Register. Contains two 8-bit data bytes.
Over-temp Shutdown threshold Register. Contains two 8-bit data bytes.
Hysteresis Register. Contains two 8-bit data bytes.
the three LSB bits of the device 7-bit address
the input pins, SCL, SDA, A2-A0, are not internally biased
OS output is an open-drain output
Tos & Thyst limits must be selected so that Tos temp value > Thyst temp value
Fault queue is defined as the number of faults that must occur consecutively
When the power supply voltage is dropped below the device power-on reset level of about 1.9 V
Temperature accuracy ±2 °C from -25 °C to +100 °C
Temperature resolution 0.125 °C
Supply quiescent current Normal mode: I2C inactive 100 µA
Supply quiescent current Shut-down mode 3.5 µA
Pin-for-pin replacement for industry standard LM75

requires_human: OS pin is optional; external pull-up resistor needed if used.
Address pins A2-A0 must not be left floating; they should be tied to GND or VCC.
Tos must be greater than Thyst for defined OS output behavior.
